messages:
sara.p: Quick gate-check for Optimize toolkit shipping heuristics + a small regression spike we saw in staging. Can teams confirm ownership for the quant profile + caching TTL change?

ben.j: I can own the quant profile PR (\u003c#PR-4123\u003e). Bench shows ~1.8x token throughput with q4_0, but a 3ms median tail on short prompts.

maya_k: can you paste the perf table? curious about short prompt regressions specifically. :eyes:

ben.j: pasted below:
```
model: redwood-7b-v1
baseline: fp16
quant: q4_0
short_prompts (<=64 tokens): median latency 18ms -> 21ms (+3ms)
long_prompts (>=512 tokens): median latency 210ms -> 145ms (-65ms)
throughput tokens/s: 230 -> 420
```

maya_k: thanks. So regressions are mainly tail for short seqs — likely KV cache alignment + batch padding overhead.

tomo: I dug in. The q4 kernel changes sizing for the KV buffer; small sequences end up doing an extra memcpy in the runtime path. I have a small patch that avoids the memcpy when seq_len < 128. Putting up PR now.

liam_r: flagged the staging eval: eval-run-2026-03-16-08 showed a 0.6% regression on top-1 accuracy for summarization testset after quant + batching. Could be tokenizer rounding differences.

ben.j: noted. That accuracy regression is in the same PR namespace — I added a compare link in PR-4123.

maya_k: ownership for caching TTL change? Our suggestion was reduce prefix cache TTL from 10m -> 2m for hosted to avoid stale prefixes on rapid-swap workloads. Who will update infra config and monitor?

sara.p: @tomo can you update the runtime default and add a deploy-bot gated flag so Dedicated customers are unaffected?

tomo: yep. I'll add a runtime feature flag `optkit.cache.prefix_ttl_ms` default 120000 and feature-gated via deploy-bot. Sample config: 
```
optkit:
  cache:
    prefix_ttl_ms: 120000
    kv_cache_capacity: 2048
    prefix_eviction_policy: lru
batching:
  max_batch_size: 32
  max_wait_ms: 15
```

ben.j: quick heads up: changing TTL in hosted reduced hit rate for long-lived prefixes by ~12% in sim; but end-to-end latency improved for mixed small-batch workloads. Recommend canary 10% for 24h.

maya_k: agree on canary. Who will monitor regressions? I'll add a dashboard for the summarization eval and the short-prompt P50/P95.

liam_r: I'll wire a regression alert: eval-delta > 0.3% or short-prompt P95 +5ms -> page.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: hosted/optkit prefix-ttl -> 120000ms at 10% traffic for 24h. Trigger: manual approve.

sara.p: Action items:
- ben.j: finalize PR-4123 (quant profile) + link perf table (owner)
- tomo: small memcpy patch + runtime feature flag + create canary rollout with deploy-bot (owner)
- maya_k: add dashboard tiles for summarization eval and short-prompt latency (owner)
- liam_r: add alert for eval-delta and P95 (owner)

ben.j: I'll ask @eng-qa to run the focused prompt set overnight. Ping me if failures.

maya_k: PR reviews needed: @sara.p for optkit semantics, @tomo for runtime changes.

sara.p: I'll review PRs by EOD PST. If all green, approve canary. :thumbsup:

liam_r: noted and will validate after 12h.

ben.j: one more note — we should document the expected tradeoffs in the Optimize docs: quant gains vs short-seq tail. I'll draft a small blurb in the guide.

sara.p: perfect. thanks all. Keep thread updated with any regressions or blocked reviews.
